mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 63 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Reddan Soccer Park. Under the first quarter moon, our overnight low will reach 59 degrees with no rain in the forecast. For the early risers, catch the space station passing overhead tomorrow at 4:55 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and traveling toward Fitchburg and Madison.

The City of Verona is busy with infrastructure updates. Phase two of the Mark Drive reconstruction is underway, involving underground utility work and future sidewalk installations. Additionally, the city is continuing its commitment to a connected transportation network through the broader sidewalk and multi-use path policy, which aims to improve safety and accessibility for everyone.

There is plenty happening in town. Today, Epic Systems hosts its annual User Group Meeting, and you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus Brewing or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and live music or trivia at local favorites like Paddy Mac's and The Bogey Factory.

Regarding the weekly police report, a notable incident occurred this past Friday when an officer conducted a traffic stop and arrested a 44-year-old woman for a first offence O W I after finding her passed out behind the wheel.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Chocolate Pecan. Please note the store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM tomorrow.
